name: ember-monorepo
description: Streakly - Full-Stack Professional Habit Streak Tracker

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npx prisma generate --schema=server/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.start: npm run prisma:migrate --workspace=server && npm run start --workspace=server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=server && npm run test --workspace=client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=server && npm run lint --workspace=client
